tool.name: ParaFEM Transient Thermal BC Generator
tool.description: Generate boundary condition, material, and control files for transient thermal analysis (p124)

param.name: mesh_d
param.label: Mesh geometry (.d)
param.help: ParaFEM .d file from mesh generator or mesh import tool

param.name: val0
param.label: Initial temperature (K)
param.help: Uniform initial temperature of the whole model

param.name: nstep
param.label: Number of time steps
param.help: Total number of time steps to simulate

param.name: npri
param.label: Output every N steps
param.help: Write results every N time steps (1 = every step)

param.name: theta
param.label: Theta parameter
param.help: Time integration parameter: 0.5 = Crank-Nicolson, 1.0 = fully implicit

param.name: limit
param.label: Max iterations
param.help: Maximum PCG solver iterations per time step

param.name: zone_config
param.label: Zone configuration (JSON)
param.help: JSON array of temperature zones. Each zone: axis_min, axis_max (normalized 0.0-1.0 along axis), temperature (K).

tool.help:
Generates ParaFEM boundary condition and material files for transient thermal analysis (p124).
Reads the mesh .d file, identifies boundary nodes, and assigns fixed temperatures to nodes falling within user-defined heater zones along the specified axis. Also writes a .mat file with material thermal properties (kx, ky, kz, rho, cp).
Zone configuration is a JSON array where each zone specifies: - axis_min, axis_max: normalized position (0.0 = mesh start, 1.0 = mesh end) - temperature: prescribed temperature in Kelvin
Time integration uses the theta method: - theta=0.5: Crank-Nicolson (second-order accurate, may oscillate) - theta=1.0: Fully implicit (first-order, unconditionally stable)
Output files: - .dat: p124 solver control parameters - .bnd: restrained nodes (empty — nr=0, all BCs via penalty method) - .fix: fixed freedom values (node, sense=1, temperature) - .mat: material properties (kx, ky, kz, rho, cp) - .d: pass-through of the input mesh file
